title: Aik Nezay Per Rida Thi, Aik Pay Sar
body:
Aik Nezay per rida thi, Aik pay sar chalta raha
Behn ki chadar ka saya, bhai pay perta raha
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Aag tou khud bujh gaye thi raat ko qayam ki
Per jigar abid ka sari zindagi jalta raha
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Janay kesa gham diya bazaar nay Sajjad ko
Umar bhar khairaat main who chadarain deta raha
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Goojhti kano main reh reh kay hansi besheer ki
Maut tak maa kay galay main teer sa chubta raha
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Lasha e Abbas per kuch na kaha tha shimr nay
Aik chadar ko authaye bus khara hansta raha
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ja baja bikhray paray thay ban main farwa kay nageen
Bhegi palkon say jinhain Shah deer tak chunta raha
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kiya tumhi Akbar ho jis ki muntazir hai ek Behan
Ja kay her ek laash pay qasid yehi kehta raha
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Khoon jo meray qalam main tha siyahi ki terhan
Raat din Akber gham-e-Shabbir main behta raha
